name: Monsieur George Hotel & Spa
description:
Monsieur George Hotel & Spa is a Paris boutique property whose interiors were designed by Anouska Hempel, set within a typical Parisian building.
The hotel has 45 rooms, room service, an on-site restaurant, a basement spa, and an exclusive wine cellar, with rooms variously offering balconies, hidden gardens, eaves suites, and a suspended patio.
The restaurant is styled in a Thousand and One Nights aesthetic, with the bar mirrored throughout and unrivalled Eiffel Tower views from the property.
